criteria.title: Complete, non-truncated output
criteria.description: Passes only if the last non-empty line isn't a bare heading or list marker (e.g. '#', '##', '-', '*', '- **'), every '**' bold marker is closed, and the final line ends with terminal punctuation (., !, ?) or a closing bold marker that follows such punctuation.

criteria.title: Word count within limits
criteria.description: Passes only if the description contains between 150 and 300 words, counted by splitting on whitespace after removing Markdown symbols (#, *, -, >).

criteria.title: Closing call to action
criteria.description: Passes only if the description ends with a clear call to action that tells the buyer to buy, order, add to cart or try the product, rather than ending on a feature or benefit statement.

criteria.title: Features clearly separated from benefits
criteria.description: Passes only if the description names concrete product features (attributes or specs) and separately explains, in active voice, how they improve the buyer's life, rather than mixing the two or listing only one.

criteria.title: Grounded claims, no fabricated quotes or weaknesses
criteria.description: Passes only if the description has no invented customer quotes or made-up review text, makes no claims that the product details don't support (no overpromising, such as guaranteed or permanent results), and mentions no product weaknesses or drawbacks.
